info.desc: The Beach Boys Today! (also known simply as Today!) is the eighth studio album by the American rock group the Beach Boys, and their first of three 1965 releases. Although few realized the significance of the album at the time, Today! marked a major transition point for the band; notably Brian Wilson's production approach. The album is noted for its sophisticated, orchestral production methods and complex arrangements. The tracks on the first half of Today! feature an electric guitar-rock oriented sound that contrasts the second half consisting of ballads, showing an increased mature lyrical depth that would foreshadow future efforts .

podcast.body: Most of the recording work for this album was completed in 1964, with its official release scheduled for early 1965. During these sessions, Brian Wilson's increasing ambition was evident, both in the emotional depth of the music and the complexity of his arrangements. He progressively incorporated session musicians to augment the group's sound. "they also did most of the work on yet another album, The Beach Boys Today, which would be released in early 1965."
